comments: Stampede and Budgie played at Reading tonight. Led Zeppelin tracks played in mono.

sessions.details: first TX 28 May 1982. Recorded 16th April 1982. Reuben Archer (vocals), Laurence Archer (guitar), Alan Wilson (keyboards), Colin Bond (bass), Frank Noon (drums). No commercial release known.

'Nothing On The TV' (LP - Rough Diamonds) Swan Song
